name: Save Backups
author: tago
description: Backs up a game's saves every time it closes, and keeps the newest copies.
details: When a game closes, its save folder is zipped into this plugin's folder. The save folder is the one set with the Save Folder plugin's "Set save folder", or else found with Ludusavi's save locations and the game's Steam App ID. Use "Open save backups" in a game's Manage menu to get to the backups, and unzip one into the save folder to restore it. Uses the tar program built into Windows 10 and newer, macOS and Linux.
affects: Copies save folders into this plugin's folder when a game closes
Adds "Back up saves now" and "Open save backups" to the Manage menu

settings.label: Show a message after each automatic backup

changelog: Backs up the save folder you set, and finds more save folders through Ludusavi (Ascendara 12.3.5 and newer).
